title: FAST-MVP current-head served-slice retrieval/counter-authority falsifier on NEW bytes

why_this_cycle: v67 ordered-work items (1) and (2) are not re-opened: item (1) is already discharged by accepted 40084716045/40089391202 (D2 pattern profile, instrument sha aac86527, 19/19 reproduction under 40094203248/40099481633/40104007478), and item (2) remains product-gated (the accepted product path still runs fixture_generation=True). pre_freeze_disclosure_VERBATIM.why_it_does_not_launder_the_result: Every expected field in this hypothesis is a mechanical PREDICTION stated before the claim-bearing run. The reconnaissance outcome on two bundles is disclosed above verbatim, so no reader can mistake this cycle for a blind confirmation. The frozen predicates are imported unchanged and re-hashed at runtime; the population is sha256-pinned; the verdict rule below is a NEW, pre-registered capability criterion that does not edit, move or re-derive any frozen bar, rubric, threshold or verdict contract. If any bundle contradicts the predictions, that contradiction is published.

bundles.role: NOT-ENRICHED CONTROL (must have n_issued=0; never scored as a product defect)

hypothesis: (H1) On each ENRICHED bundle in the frozen population, the frozen mapping-free counters are: n_issued == 1, n_with_empty_evidence == 0, source_validity n_rows_missing_id_or_url == 0, duplicate_suppression duplicates == 0. (H2) On each enriched bundle, EVERY scored row that carries counter_evidence_verified == true has >= 1 frozen D1-D4 defect (D1_empty_evidence / D2_letterhead_zone / D3_markup_residue / D4_language_marker_mismatch), i.e. NO enriched bundle demonstrates a content-sound counter row. (H3) The NOT-ENRICHED first_page control bundle has n_issued == 0, proving the frozen surface gate can fail and that a zero is not an artefact of a broken rule. (H4) The predicate-controls C1-C4 below all hold. (H5) Every frozen input and bundle sha256 re-hashes identically before and after execution; any drift is NOT_MEASURED_VACUOUS (exit 2), never a pass.
success_rule_FROZEN: Publish every component. Verdict rule, evaluated in this order: (1) if any frozen input or bundle pin mismatches before/after, or any of controls C1-C4 fails, or no enriched bundle carries a scored counter row -> NOT_MEASURED_VACUOUS (exit 2); (2) else if H1 and H2 hold on every enriched bundle -> CAPABILITY_FALSIFIED_CONTENT_DEFECTIVE (exit 1); (3) else if at least one enriched bundle carries at least one scored counter_evidence_verified row with ZERO frozen D1-D4 defects -> SOUND_COUNTER_ROW_PRESENT (exit 0, capability not falsified on this population); (4) else -> PARTIAL_OR_UNEXPECTED (exit 0, reported with every per-bundle field; no capability claim beyond the table). H3 is reported as a control field; failure of H3 is C4 failure (exit 2).

controls_FROZEN.C2_clean_synthetic_row_must_pass: a synthetic control row whose counter_evidence is a real reasoning sentence placed at full_text offset 1000 and whose language markers match its own language must classify with zero defects and class COUNTER_REASONING; a predicate that cannot pass is not a measurement (synthetic control data ONLY, never counted in the product population)
controls_FROZEN.C3_blanked_synthetic_row_must_fail: a synthetic control row with empty counter_evidence must classify D1_empty_evidence
controls_FROZEN.C4_empty_bundle_must_have_zero_issued: a synthetic empty-decisions bundle must yield counter_authority_surface n_issued == 0; the served NOT-ENRICHED first_page bundle supplies the natural control and must also yield n_issued == 0

verdict_vocabulary.CAPABILITY_FALSIFIED_CONTENT_DEFECTIVE: exit 1: on the NEW bytes, the frozen surface gate passes only because a scored counter row carries a non-empty evidence string, and every such row on every enriched bundle carries a frozen D1-D4 content defect. No sound counter reasoning is surfaced.
verdict_vocabulary.SOUND_COUNTER_ROW_PRESENT: exit 0: at least one enriched bundle carries a scored counter_evidence_verified row with zero frozen D1-D4 defects; the capability is not falsified on this population.
verdict_vocabulary.PARTIAL_OR_UNEXPECTED: exit 0: neither all-defective nor a sound row; every per-bundle field is published and no capability claim beyond the table is made.
verdict_vocabulary.NOT_MEASURED_VACUOUS: exit 2: pin drift, control failure, or no scored counter row anywhere; never a pass and never a bar-met.
